$comment: Worked example of the media pipeline. The 'app' here is THIS docs site — serve the production build and shoot it: npm run serve -- --port 3300 --no-open, then npm run media -- --manifest tools/media/help-center.json --base http://localhost:3300. Same trick tools/flows/getting-started-tour.mjs already uses for video, so the framework can demonstrate capture/record/drift/audit with no product app and no product data. Selectors are stable Docusaurus theme classes and aria-labels rather than data-testids, because the subject is the docs theme itself. NOTE: the three endpoint-page shots below target /developers/projects-api/create-project, which `npm run drop-sample` removes — after graduating, point them at one of YOUR endpoint pages and reshoot. The reshoot fails loudly on a 404 rather than silently keeping a stale image. Copy this file's shape for your own module.

screenshots.$comment: The code block's expand button is deliberately NOT shot here: it lives at opacity 0 until hover, and capture.mjs now refuses to outline an invisible element rather than saving a screenshot with no visible highlight. Hover-only affordances belong in a video, not a still.
